queries.a1:
-- A1 (separable box: each row takes its best value in its own range).
-- Ship each part offer as close to 5,000 units as its available stock allows.
-- decision: ship
-- objective: SUM(POWER(ship - 5000, 2))
SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ship
DECIDE ship(REAL)
FROM partsupp
SUCH THAT ship BETWEEN 0 AND ps_availqty
MINIMIZE SUM(POWER(ship - 5000, 2))
queries.r1:
-- R1 (continuous knapsack: one budget per group over REAL decisions).
-- A1 with a cap: each part takes at most 5,000 units in total across its suppliers.
-- decision: ship
-- objective: SUM(ps_supplycost * ship)
SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_supplycost, ship
DECIDE ship(REAL)
FROM partsupp
SUCH THAT ship BETWEEN 0 AND ps_availqty AND SUM(ship) by (ps_partkey) <= 5000
MAXIMIZE SUM(ps_supplycost * ship)
queries.r1_global:
-- R1 (continuous knapsack: one budget over REAL decisions), the form of the paper's listing.
-- Take a fraction of each part offer, spending at most a tenth of the total cost, to secure the most stock.
-- decision: ship
-- objective: SUM(ps_availqty * ship)
SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, ship
DECIDE ship(REAL)
FROM partsupp
SUCH THAT ship BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND SUM(ship * ps_supplycost) <= 0.1 * SUM(ps_supplycost)
MAXIMIZE SUM(ps_availqty * ship)
queries.s1:
-- S1 (uniform matroid: choose K rows by score).
-- Each supplier fills at most two of its part offers; keep the offers with the most stock available.
-- decision: pick
-- objective: SUM(ps_availqty * pick)
SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, pick
DECIDE pick(BOOL)
FROM partsupp
SUCH THAT SUM(pick) by (ps_suppkey) <= 2
MAXIMIZE SUM(ps_availqty * pick)
queries.s1_global:
-- S1 (uniform matroid: choose K rows by score), one bound over every row.
-- Keep the tenth of all part offers with the most stock available.
-- decision: pick
-- objective: SUM(ps_availqty * pick)
SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, pick
DECIDE pick(BOOL)
FROM partsupp
SUCH THAT SUM(pick) <= 0.1 * COUNT(*)
MAXIMIZE SUM(ps_availqty * pick)

solver_threads: solver default (DeciDB sets no thread count)
